body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
Stablecoin market cap tops $240B (USDT ~67%, USDC ~27%) as the GENIUS Act's July 18 rulemaking deadline passed without final rules from regulators.
Stablecoin News
GENIUS Act rulemaking deadline missed
Six federal agencies missed the July 18 statutory deadline to finalize GENIUS Act stablecoin rules; issuers still await final capital and charter requirements.
Tether launches USAT for US compliance
Tether is rolling out USAT, a new US-domiciled stablecoin built for GENIUS Act compliance, while pursuing a foreign-issuer path for USDT itself.
Stablecoin market cap passes $240B
Outstanding stablecoin supply now exceeds $240 billion, with Tether's USDT holding roughly 67% share and Circle's USDC around 27%.
Fidelity and Samsung push mainstream adoption
Fidelity Digital Assets announced its first stablecoin, FIDD, on Ethereum, while Samsung said it will add native stablecoin support to Samsung Wallet.
Hacking & Security Incidents
AFX bridge exploit drains $24M on Arbitrum
Attackers compromised five validator keys to hit quorum on an AFX-powered bridge, draining $24.15M in USDC and converting it to ETH (July 22).
Triple-A hot wallets drained of $9.7M
Crypto payments firm Triple-A had hot wallets across TRON, Ethereum, TON and Solana drained of roughly $9.7M in stablecoins and liquid assets (July 24-25).
Lien Finance loses $542K in bond-pricing exploit
Attackers manipulated bond pricing in Lien Finance's OTC pools on Ethereum to drain USDC liquidity on July 24.
"Hackers' Day" totals $35.5M across 3 exploits
On July 23, three separate DeFi exploits totaled $35.55M in losses, pushing the month's cumulative hack losses toward $100M.
